raw.rationale: This is a reversible EGFR/ERBB2/VEGFR inhibitor tested at 2.5 µM for 5 days, a concentration high enough to inhibit wild-type EGFR and likely ERBB2/KDR, so selective killing is most plausible in EGFR- or ERBB2-addicted lineages such as lung (EGFR-mutant/amplified), breast (ERBB2-amplified), and upper aerodigestive/gastric/esophageal tumors with EGFR/ERBB2 dependence; most other lineages lack such oncogene addiction and should show low selectivity probabilities near the base rate.
